base_panel_policy.diversity_role: Maximal parameter coverage across (coeff, AP, condition_threshold)
base_panel_policy.controls_role: Mid and lower IS Sharpe candidates for unpenalized decay baseline

winner_union_policy.description: If an arm selects a candidate outside the top 16 base panel, that candidate is appended to the forward evaluation set before reading forward data.

label_formulation.sharpe_decay_formula: D_{k, theta} = SR_{IS180, k, theta} - SR_{FWD14, k, theta}
label_formulation.relative_decay_formula: Y_{k, theta} = D_{k, theta} - D_{k, anchor}
label_formulation.relative_sharpe_gain_formula: Q_{k, theta} = SR_{FWD, k, theta} - SR_{FWD, k, anchor} = SR_{IS, k, theta} - SR_{IS, k, anchor} - Y_{k, theta}
label_formulation.target_interpretation: Lower Y represents less Sharpe decay relative to stock Mode 4 anchor; negative Y means the candidate outperformed the anchor in forward persistence.

archive_policy.origin_weight_normalization: EQUAL_WEIGHT_PER_MATURED_ORIGIN: sum_{theta} w_{k, theta} = 1.0, total_weight_k = 1.0 / K
archive_policy.failure_policy: NO_ZERO_FILLING: failed or censored trials keep explicit status and reason
